apps.name: The Appiverse
apps.notes: Main command surface for connected Illco apps, shared login, app subscriptions, launch handoff, and admin visibility.
apps.qaNote: Public Appiverse surface is reachable; backend database health is tracked separately by the backend status row.

apps.name: iLL-Motion
apps.notes: AI music-video platform for Google/Veo scene generation, selective lip-sync, viral shorts, action scenes, and final assembly when provider credits are available. Launch access uses shared Illco login, payment checkout, and credits.
apps.qaNote: Production /api/status verifies Gemini/Veo config, RunPod lip-sync bridge, Blob storage, Groq, ElevenLabs, ffmpeg/ffprobe, and silent music-video scene policy without exposing secrets. Shared Illco OAuth, SSO launch handoff, payment checkout, and credit unlock routing are wired through Illco Command.

apps.name: VoiceBook
apps.notes: Book-writing and narration workspace with Groq chat/planning routes, project sync, STT, and optional ElevenLabs server TTS.
apps.qaNote: Public VoiceBook surface is reachable; legacy child health route requires local Stripe env even though checkout is centralized through Appiverse.

apps.name: Barz Web Studio
apps.notes: Browser Barz studio for lyric generation, rewrites, diagnostics, music-prompt planning, style vaults, kept-draft protection, exact score targets, server-side OpenAI Responses generation, and server wallet credits.
apps.qaNote: Local Next production build passes; /api/bootstrap reports provider-ready with OpenAI configured; /api/run returned a real openai-responses result and usage data; wallet ledger is now server-owned locally. Hidden from public display because the production URL does not currently return a public 2xx/3xx response.

apps.name: Illco Voice
apps.notes: Spoken assistant layer using Groq for command routing and ElevenLabs for speech replies inside creative workflows.
apps.qaNote: Voice readiness is covered by the shared iLL-Motion /api/status endpoint; POST /api/voice/respond remains the action-level voice check.

apps.name: Illco Toolbox
apps.notes: Selectable app and tool launcher formerly called Companions, now positioned as the Toolbox surface inside the Appiverse.
apps.qaNote: Static Appiverse hub and live /api/status API are deployed; next step is migrating the best selectable-box UI into this command surface.

apps.name: Agent GPT
apps.notes: Groq reasoning agent workspace for turning business goals into execution plans, follow-up task continuations, risk elimination passes, and first useful deliverables. Launch access uses shared Illco login, payment checkout, and credits.
apps.qaNote: Production root is reachable; /api/groq-agent remains the action plane for streaming execution. No public /api/health route is currently exposed, so registry health probing falls back to root reachability.

apps.name: Agent GPT Runner
apps.notes: OpenAI Agents SDK runner for submitting hardened Illco Agent GPT goals, validating Groq-backed model output, redacting sensitive handoff values, and converting weak app results into polished execution plans. Uses the production Agent GPT app surface with the local Codex skill as the operating workspace.
apps.qaNote: Agent GPT now runs through @openai/agents orchestration with Groq configured as the OpenAI-compatible model provider. Local Codex skill passed quick_validate.py and helper payload validation; local smoke reached the SDK route but the stored local Groq key returned 401.

apps.name: Private Pilot TV

apps.qaNote: Local prototype verified on June 15, 2026 at http://127.0.0.1:8091/. UI uses broadcast language, gates broadcast access behind accepted pilots, and includes pilot pitch, programming review, and monetization flows. Hidden from public display because live streaming capabilities have been removed from Illco Command.
